start: The desk tapped 'Request workout report' on the member's page; member has workouts since joining

user_sees: Card 'Send your report to the gym?' with '<gym> wants a copy of your workouts from <join day>, the day you joined: exercises, sets, weights, reps and your notes. The gym owner and desk can see it. Older workouts stay on your phone.'
must_not: Anything sent before the member answers

user_sees: 'Sending your report…'
must_not: Workouts from before the join day at this gym in the file

user_sees: 'Report sent to the gym.' and 'Want your own copy? Go to Settings and save all your workouts.'
must_not: The report sent to any other gym, or 'sent' shown when the upload failed

start: Member says no, or the send is refused

user_sees: 'OK. Nothing was sent to the gym.'
must_not: Any workout data sent after No

steps.action: Yes, but the report is over 3,000,000 characters
user_sees: 'We could not send your report because it is too big. Please tell the gym desk.'
must_not: A cut-off report sent without a word

steps.action: Yes, but the desk cancelled meanwhile / gym suspended / offline
user_sees: 'The gym no longer needs this report.' / 'Your gym is not taking reports in the app right now.' / "Couldn't send it. Check your internet and try again." with 'Try again'
must_not: 'Report sent' for a failed send

start: Request states: pending, agreed but not attached, sent, expired

steps.action: Say yes, then lose signal before the file goes
user_sees: The card keeps 'Try again' (agreed, file still on its way)
must_not: The member asked again whether to send, or the yes lost

user_sees: The card goes; the desk sees 'No report came within 30 days.'
must_not: An expired request still asking

steps.action: Member with no workouts since joining says yes
user_sees: A report with only the header is sent
must_not: A crash or an endless 'Sending your report…'

user_sees: Only this gym's owner and desk see the file; only workouts since the join day
must_not: Another gym, other members or MettleUp support reading the file without the gym's support window
